title: Api cost
description: The body of GET /api/cost: the cost ledger rolled up for the cost panel. It has five blocks — running totals, a breakdown per decision backend, a daily series, the prices the numbers were computed with, and the newest ledger rows. Only successful decisions are billed, so a failed call appears in no block.

usage_totals.title: Usage totals
usage_totals.description: Money and tokens over a set of billed decisions.

backend_totals.title: Backend totals
backend_totals.description: The totals of one decision backend, with the model they were billed against.

model.description: Model identifier the rows were billed against.

ledger_row.title: Ledger row
ledger_row.description: One billed decision, as app.cost_ledger stores it.

model.description: Model identifier the row was billed against.

input_tokens.description: Input tokens the backend reported for this call.

output_tokens.description: Output tokens the backend reported for this call.

cost_usd.description: Cost of this call in US dollars.

by_backend.description: One entry per decision backend that has billed rows.

by_day.description: Cost per wall-clock day, oldest first.

day_wall.description: The wall-clock day in UTC, as a calendar date.

usd.description: Cost of that day in US dollars.

prices.description: The prices the numbers above were computed with. A backend that bills nothing has null prices.

von_input_per_mtok.description: Price of a million input tokens of the decision model, in US dollars.

llm_input_per_mtok.description: Price of a million input tokens of the language-model backend, null while it is not configured.

llm_output_per_mtok.description: Price of a million output tokens of the language-model backend, null while it is not configured.

as_of.description: The day the prices were last checked.

recent.description: The newest billed decisions, newest first, at most fifty.
